lines.text: # C01 S1 — Read-only Job-wide commit limit feasibility gate
Date: 2026-11-02. Scope: design and evidence audit ONLY; no actual Windows changes or inference.

* Windows Job Object JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY is documented and technically applicable to the existing KillOnCloseJob structure, with a new bounded configuration and verification path: **FEASIBLE IN PRINCIPLE**.
* S2 bounded mock implementation and S3 Windows tests: **CONDITIONAL GO**.
* Real diagnostic ③-C on current 16-GiB RAM / 1-GiB pagefile: **NO-GO, pending distinct final gate**.
* No specific safe GiB limit can be established from existing logs alone.
